```sql
SELECT c.name AS name, SUM(o.total) AS spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.created >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING SUM(o.total) > 100
ORDER BY spent DESC;
```

Divisible by 3: ⌊1000/3⌋ = 333  
Divisible by 5: ⌊1000/5⌋ = 200  
Divisible by 15: ⌊1000/15⌋ = 66  

Divisible by 3 or 5: 333 + 200 − 66 = 467  
Exclude those divisible by 15: 467 − 66 = 401  

ANSWER: 401
